lines.t: Yeah… this one’s for the faithful hearts.
Beloved… be My examples.
Order your speech like David in the field,
Sing with a soul no storm can still.
Conduct yourselves like Daniel in the flame,
When lions roar, still praise His name.
Every word you speak, let it carry love,
Every step you take, be led from above.
Let your heart be louder than your fear,
’Cause heaven’s whisper’s always near.
Beloved, we rise, we ride, we reign,
Through the fire, through the wind, through pain.
Let your tongue be bridled by the light,
’Cause a right heart turns the darkness bright.
Beloved, prepare like He’s coming today,
Walk in the Garden, don’t drift away.
A forgiving heart heals every mind—
Peace like thunder, strong yet kind.
In the open or secret, stand true and clear,
Let His Spirit be the one they hear.
No fake shine, no borrowed glow,
Just grace in motion everywhere you go.
Talk straight, walk clean,
Keep your heart where His hands have been.
When the hurt comes knockin’, don’t bow down,
Turn forgiveness into your crown.
Beloved, we rise, we ride, we reign,
Through the fire, through the wind, through pain.
Let your tongue be bridled by the light,
’Cause a right heart turns the darkness bright.
Beloved, prepare like He’s coming today,
Walk in the Garden, don’t drift away.
A forgiving heart heals every mind—
Peace like thunder, strong yet kind.
Beloved, prepare like He’s coming today,
Walk in the Garden, don’t drift away.
A forgiving heart heals every mind—
Peace like thunder, strong yet kind.
Beloved…
Walk with Me as though we walk together already.
A right heart bridles the tongue.
A forgiving heart brings peace forever.
